title: How to Use This App
heroSub: Study method · hints · model tests. Learn the best way to prepare with TaxiPilot: vocabulary first, clue words next, section practice, then timed model tests.
step1: Start with Vocabulary. The words are organized by topic, so you can learn the most useful Finnish words for each part of the taxi exam.
step2: Learn WH Words and Conjunctions. WH words help you understand what the question is asking; conjunctions help you understand sentence logic such as reason, condition, exception, contrast, or time order.
step3: Use Positive and Negative Clue Words. Positive clue words help you find the correct answer faster; negative clue words help you remove wrong options first.
step4: Practise by Official Exam Section. Do not practise randomly — prepare section by section, check your mistakes, and revise the weak section before moving forward.
step5: Use the Hint System. The hint system shows useful focus words, positive clue words, negative clue words, and short explanations.
step6: Track Your Progress. Use your progress result to see which section needs more work. Focus on accuracy, weak topics, and repeated mistakes.
step7: Finish with Timed Model Tests. The model tests follow the real taxi exam structure, including the section distribution and exam-style difficulty.
